claim: Skills named in current technical AI / machine-learning job posts on each company's own careers site (home page section 'What AI teams hire for').

method.public_job_feeds: OpenAI and Sarvam AI (Ashby), Anthropic and Databricks (Greenhouse), Amazon (amazon.jobs), Hugging Face (Workable), Meesho (Lever), and others: every listed post was read; engineering/research/science roles kept; company boilerplate (sentences repeated in 25%+ of a company's posts) ignored; skills matched by keyword.
method.manual_research: Google, Microsoft, Meta, Swiggy, PhonePe: posts found on the official careers sites, then a second agent re-opened every post and confirmed each quote verbatim, the post live, and the skill named.

not_listed.Flipkart: careers page could not be read (JavaScript-only applicant tracker)
not_listed.Razorpay: no open AI/ML roles on its public board
not_listed.NVIDIA: job feed rate-limited the check, so no post was verified
